units.source_text: 源氏公子自己觉得：现在再像青年时代那样写情书，甚不相称。

en.t: Prince Genji himself felt that writing love letters now, as he had in his youth, would be quite unbecoming.

units.source_text: 但回想槿姬向来取不即不离的态度，终于至今不曾玉成好事，又觉得决不肯就此罢手。

en.t: But when he thought back on Princess Asagao's habitually distant yet not wholly rejecting manner, and on how the affair had still never come to fruition, he felt that he absolutely could not give up now.

units.source_text: 便恢复勇气，重新向她热烈求爱。

en.t: So he recovered his courage and began courting her ardently once again.

units.source_text: 他独自离居在东殿里，召唤宣旨前来，和她商量办法。

en.t: Living apart by himself in the eastern wing, he summoned Senji and consulted with her about what to do.

units.source_text: 槿姬身边的侍女个个多情，看见毫不足道的男子都要倾心，何况对源氏公子。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting around Princess Asagao were all susceptible to feeling; they would lose their hearts even to men of no account, so how much more to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 看那极口赞誉的样子，简直要铸成大错呢。

en.t: Seeing how extravagantly they praised him, one felt they were on the verge of bringing about a grave mistake.

units.source_text: 至于槿姬自己呢，从前年轻时代尚且凛不可犯，

en.t: As for Princess Asagao herself, even in her younger days she had possessed a dignity that no one could presume upon.

units.source_text: 何况现在双方年龄增长，地位也高了，岂肯做那种风流韵事？

en.t: Now that both of them were older and their rank had risen, how could she possibly consent to such a romantic affair?

units.source_text: 她觉得即使偶尔在通信中吟风弄月，亦恐世人讥评为轻薄。

en.t: She felt that even if she merely exchanged the occasional poetic allusion in letters, people might mock her as frivolous.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得这位小姐的性情全同昔年一样，毫无改变，实在异乎寻常。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that this lady's nature was exactly as it had been long ago, unchanged in the least, and truly extraordinary.
It was truly rare, and maddening as well.
